# The Payments API
Accept payments with three lines of code.

---

## Why developers switch

:::cards style=glass cols=3
- lightning | Fast | Median response under 80 ms
- shield-check | Safe | PCI handled for you
- code | Typed | SDKs for TS, Go and Python
:::

---

## Three lines

```ts checkout.ts {2|3}
import { Payments } from "@acme/payments";
const pay = new Payments(process.env.ACME_KEY);
await pay.charge({ amount: 4200, currency: "usd" });
```

---

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Includes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | Free | 1k requests / month |
| Growth | 0.4% | Unlimited requests |
| Scale | Custom | SLA and support |

---

## Get started

> [!TIP] `npm i @acme/payments` and read the docs at acme.dev

# Checkout latency spike
Blameless review · 42 minutes of degraded service

---

## Impact

:::stats style=big
- 42m | Degraded
- 18% | Checkouts slowed
- 0 | Data lost
:::

---

## Timeline

:::timeline style=v
- 09:12 | p99 latency alert fires
- 09:20 | Rollback of release 5.3.1
- 09:34 | Cache warmed, latency normal
- 09:54 | Incident closed
:::

---

## Root cause

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Release 5.3.1] --> B[Cache key change]
  B --> C[Cold cache]
  C --> D[DB overload]
```

---

## Follow-ups

- [ ] Canary cache hit-rate before full rollout
- [ ] Alert on cache miss ratio, not just latency
- [ ] Runbook: warm cache after key changes
